tours.name: Donauinsel Northbound Ride
tours.description: Flat riverside bike route with steady paths, open views, and easy bailout points.

tours.name: Belvedere to Stadtpark Walk
tours.description: Short city walk through central Vienna with museums, gardens, and cafes close by.

tours.name: Kahlenberg Ridge Hike
tours.description: Moderate ridge hike with forest shade, vineyard edges, and a proper viewpoint finish.

tours.name: Wachau Big Bike Day
tours.description: Long rolling ride through the Wachau with river stretches, climbs, and several village stops.

tours.name: Schneeberg Summit Day
tours.description: Big mountain hike with a long climb, exposed sections, and changing weather near the top.

tours.name: Wienerwald Gravel Ride
tours.description: Mixed-surface ride from Huetteldorf into the Wienerwald with forest roads, punchy climbs, and a fast finish toward Purkersdorf.

tours.name: Neusiedler See Southbound Ride
tours.description: Open, windy endurance ride along the lake toward Rust with exposed sections and steady pacing.

tours.name: Airport Pickup Drive
tours.description: Simple vehicle route from the city center to Vienna airport.

tours.name: Rax Plateau Traverse
tours.description: Full-day alpine traverse with a long approach and wide views across the plateau.

tours.name: Prater Hauptallee 5K
tours.description: Straightforward 5K training run on the Hauptallee, paced for an easy half-hour effort.

tours.name: Danube Canal Tempo Run
tours.description: Flat out-and-back run along the canal, good for controlled tempo sessions.

tours.name: Prater Family Ride
tours.description: Gentle park ride with shade, broad paths, and plenty of places to stop.
